profile.name: Marcus Holloway
profile.summary: PMP-certified construction project engineer with 6 years delivering lab, cleanroom and manufacturing facility buildouts from scope development to closeout.

descriptions: Managed 9 capital projects ($2M–$18M) for biotech and aerospace clients, including two ISO 7 cleanroom suites
Built project budgets and construction schedules in Smartsheet; delivered 8 of 9 projects on or under budget
Ran bid leveling for 40+ subcontractor proposals per project and recommended contractor selection
Drafted and administered subcontracts, negotiating change orders worth $1.4M in total
Coordinated design reviews with A&E consultants and checked drawings against city building codes
Secured building permits and scheduled city inspections for 14 permit packages
Logged and tracked 600+ RFIs and 350 submittals; reviewed monthly pay applications against schedule of values
Expedited long-lead MEP equipment procurement, recovering 5 weeks on a fab expansion
Led weekly site visits and EHS walks with superintendents; zero recordable incidents across 180,000 labor hours
Presented weekly status and risk updates to owner stakeholders and facilities teams
Prepared structural calculations and Revit models for 12 steel-frame warehouses
Procore, Smartsheet, Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, MS Project
